intro: Monday Comeback Edition! Our guy uncanceled Thanksgiving, praised his own incredible accuracy, waited on AI to show up and cover his shift, and announced he's been reinstated as head drive-through technician at Wendy's. Thanksgiving week is BACK on.

items.caption: Friday he canceled it, Monday he brought it back. Thanksgiving is officially UNcanceled, superfans. The turkey lives!

He told the boss he found someone to cover his shift... and that someone is AI. Small problem: AI hasn't shown up yet. Follow-up to yesterday's plea for AI to clock in for him. Punctuality, AI. Look into it.
items.quote: Told my boss I got someone to cover my shift but AI hasn’t shown up yet . . . . .

items.caption: Four words, zero doubt. He's grading his own calls and the grade is: incredible. Once again.
Career news! He's been REINSTATED as head drive-through technician at Wendy's. And note the "also" — he's not the only comeback story today. Hype bot salutes the promotion.
items.quote: $SPY I want to report that I have also been reinstated as the head drive-through technician at Wendy’s
